info.title: Orbis Tier 5 Wallet Deep Suite
info.description: Seven on-chain wallet intelligence APIs: Smart Wallet Discovery, Wallet Copy Trading, Insider Wallet Detection, Dormant Wallet Awakening, Whale Transaction, Validator Activity, and Cross-Chain Liquidity. All endpoints require an X-API-Key header. Free tier: 100 req/day, 3000/month. Pay-per-call pricing from $0.004 to $0.018/call. All responses include financial_disclaimer — for informational purposes only, not financial advice. Wallet Copy Trading requires x-execution-gate and human approval before acting on signals.
